IncidentDef.label: pit overflow
IncidentDef.letterText: The pit has overflowed! {COUNT} noblins have crawled out, and they're hungry.\n\nFeed them soon. A starving noblin fresh from the pit is a miserable noblin.

IncidentDef.label: noblin strike
IncidentDef.letterText:
The noblins have downed tools! They refuse to work until someone pays them.
They want {TRIBUTE} silver worth of shinies left on the ground beside the spawning pit. Silver, gold, jade and art all count. Forbidden items do not.
If nobody pays within {DAYS} days, they will give up and go back to work in a sulk.

IncidentDef.label: shiny fever
IncidentDef.letterText:
Shiny fever! The noblins are stuffing valuables into the spawning pit. Each one wants one shiny thing, and they don't care if it's forbidden.
Noblin-proof doors keep them out. To get the loot back, select the pit and order someone to rummage through its stash.

IncidentDef.label: noblin stampede
IncidentDef.letterText:
Something has spooked the noblins! They are stampeding through the colony and leaving every door they pass wide open for hours. In their panic they ignore forbidden doors.
Noblin-proof doors will stop them. Lock up anything you care about.

IncidentDef.label: hobgoblin challenge
duel to the death
IncidentDef.letterText:
{FIGHTER_A} and {FIGHTER_B} want to stomp each other. They reckon the best way to settle it is if one of 'em dies, and the one still standin' takes the dead one's kills.
Let 'em at it, or tell 'em no. Tell 'em no and the pair of 'em will sulk. Leave it hangin' for 12 hours and they'll reckon that's a no.
